TWO_MECHANISMS_ISOLATED_BY_CONTROL.A_expert_scale_resolution: e2g64-o4g64 (2.6251, COHERENT, 4gram 0.000) vs e2g128-o4g64 (2.4058, COLLAPSED, 4gram 0.914). Bits held at 2; ONLY the expert group size changed 64->128. Capability falls off a cliff. The expert organ requires one scale/bias per <=64 weights. This is a SCALE-RESOLUTION bound, not a bit-width bound.
TWO_MECHANISMS_ISOLATED_BY_CONTROL.B_non_expert_precision: Experts pinned at the coherent 2b/g64; only non-experts varied. o4g64 COHERENT (ppl 3.52) -> o3g128 DEGRADED (ppl 5.02) -> o2g128 DESTROYED (ppl 44034.7). The non-expert organ is ~9.8% of the bytes but is FAR more precision-sensitive than the 90.2% expert organ. Attention, router, embed and lm_head at 2 bits destroy the model outright.

PPL_ALONE_WOULD_HAVE_PASSED_A_BROKEN_MOD: e2g128-o4g64 has ppl 4.0847 - only 41% above bf16's 2.894, a number that reads as an acceptable quantization cost. Its generation emits 89 CONSECUTIVE IDENTICAL TOKENS with a 4-gram repeat rate of 0.914. Teacher-forced NLL is blind to decode collapse because every position is conditioned on ground truth. Any acceptance gate scoring only perplexity would have shipped this.
INVALID_NUMBER_REJECTED: e2g128-o2g128 reported decode 41,985.57 tok/s. That model emits EOS after ~8 tokens, so the 16- and 80-token runs terminate at the SAME length and the marginal denominator (d80-d16) collapses toward zero. The number is an artifact of the marginal method meeting early termination, not a measurement. Same failure class as the 7,061,969 tok/s prefill. Harness needs a generated-length guard before any further TPS work.
SCOPE_LIMIT_THIS_IS_NOT_PROVEN_UNABLE: This bounds ONE representation class: post-hoc affine quantization, uncalibrated. Directive S001 requires PROVEN_UNABLE to exhaust the relevant representation classes. Directive section 8 says the real problem is capability-preserving REPRESENTATION SEARCH, not precision reduction - and this result is exactly that argument made quantitatively. The <=1.0 EBPW target cannot be reached by turning quantization knobs, which is the G007 blocker: the gauntlet's candidate_space() can only parse q(N)/g(N) spec strings, so it cannot express any of the classes that could.
CAVEATS: ppl is one fixed 512-token passage; the coherence metrics are the load-bearing gate here.
Greedy decoding throughout; sampling could mask or worsen repetition.

Uncalibrated affine quantization. A calibrated method (activation-aware) would likely move this bound, and prior work on this machine measured activation-weighted SVD at 1.9-3.9x better than its unweighted counterpart. The bound is for the class as tested.
